name: Wolfevel
look: a scrappy green werewolf on two legs with a wild orange mane, red eyes, fangs, spiky orange fur cuffs, green fists with red claws, a leafy vine belt, huge clawed feet and a spiky orange-to-red tail
entry: It has started walking on two legs and picks fights with anything bigger than itself, just to prove it can. Its tail turns redder the angrier it gets.
how: Evolve Wigwoof at level 16. It learns Double Kick when it evolves.
